paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: This figure comprises six bar charts, divided into two sets: MATH-500 and AIME24. The charts in each set compare the performance of various LLMs using different methods, namely Chain of Thought (CoT) and Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling (TTS). In the MATH-500 and AIME24 charts, the horizontal axis represents model types or sizes, labeled as 3B, unk, 405B, 1.5B, 671B, and 7B, while the vertical axis represents performance scores, ranging from 65 to 100 for MATH-500 and 0 to 90 for AIME24, with a linear scale. For MATH-500 (a), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct has a score of 78.2, GPT-4o has a score of 71.4, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct has a score of 74.6, and TTS has a score of 90.0. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B in (b) has a score of 91.6. In (c), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B has a score of 97.3, o1-preview has a score of 95.2, and o1 has a score of 94.8. For AIME24 (d), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct has a score of 30.0, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct has a score of 23.3, and GPT-4o has a score of 9.3. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B in (e) has a score of 63.6, and o1-mini has a score of 44.6. In (f), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B has a score of 83.3, o1 has a score of 79.8, and DeepSeek-R1 has a score of 79.2. The bars are colored according to the legend provided and are not sorted in any specific order.
